resources.string: Displays the Earth or Mars instance of the Lukashian Calendar
The functionality of this app is provided via a widget. Please go to your homescreen and add the Lukashian Calendar widget. You can even add two, one for Earth and one for Mars!
The instance indicator is useful when you have multiple instances of the calendar widget on your screen. If the text looks too small as a result, consider resizing the widget horizontally.
On some devices, there is a limit on how often a widget can update itself on the screen. If beeps update in an irregular pattern, you can always tap the widget to update it.
